blocks.text: BARCELONA, Spain — Spain’s interim lower house of parliament on Thursday ratified housing measures designed to limit evictions and real estate speculation, a day after a general strike and major street protests over the country’s housing cost crunch. The duration of the approved measures, however, will likely depend on the outcome of a national election set for later this month. The leading opposition party, the conservative Popular Party, has said that it will repeal the housing measures of the left-wing government if it takes power, which polls indicate is a real possibility. “Yesterday, the right to housing won on the street […]...
